questions.question: What did Israel do at Gilgal before taking the land?
options: Were circumcised and kept the Passover
Offered sacrifices and chose new judges
Fought a battle and divided the spoil
Built a temple and crowned a king
questions.answer: Were circumcised and kept the Passover

questions.question: What happened to the manna in this chapter?
options: It increased to feed the whole army each day
It stopped after they ate the produce of the land
It turned bitter and could no longer be eaten at all
It continued falling just as it had before
questions.answer: It stopped after they ate the produce of the land

questions.question: Joshua met the commander of the LORD's army, who told him to remove his sandals.
The _____ stopped the day after they ate the produce of Canaan.
The commander of the LORD's army told Joshua to take off his _____, for the ground was holy.
